title: feat: add DeepSeek V4.1 Flash
author: tomdacatto
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds canonical `deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash` via Fireworks `accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v4p1-flash`.
- Transfers `deepseek` and `deepseek-flash`; adds `deepseek-v4.1`, `deepseek-v4.1-flash`, `deepseek-v4p1`, and `deepseek-v4p1-flash` aliases.
- Mirrors V4 Flash text-only capabilities, tools/reasoning, 1,048,576 context, 60 RPM, Quest Pollen eligibility, priceMultiplier 1, and $0.22/$0.007/$0.66 per million input/cached/output tokens; no fallback.
- Updates the stored-permission migration and economics identity bridge for the transferred generic `deepseek` alias.
- Tests: enter migration + aliases 479/479; effective-prices snapshot pass/update; gen resolver 62/62; reasoning transforms 38/38; model registry 2/2; gen typecheck passes; Biome and git diff --check pass.
- Enter typecheck remains blocked by pre-existing frontend/@pollinations/ui API mismatches. Live provider/Tinybird checks were unavailable because this isolated worktree has no decrypted provider/local test credentials.

No APIDOCS.md changes.

gist.headline: A flash in the DeepSeek
gist.blurb: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash just landed in the hive: a fast text model with a truly unreasonable amount of room to think. Bring your tools, reasoning prompts, and very long context windows.
gist.summary: Added DeepSeek V4.1 Flash via Fireworks as `deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash`, with tool use, reasoning, a 1,048,576-token context window, 60 RPM, Quest Pollen eligibility, and aliases including `deepseek`, `deepseek-flash`, and `deepseek-v4.1`.
gist.impact: Developers can now call DeepSeek V4.1 Flash through the unified text API at $0.22/$0.007/$0.66 per million input/cached/output tokens, while existing generic DeepSeek aliases continue to resolve through the updated registry and permissions bridge.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a tiny librarian-bee with round reading glasses guiding a glowing DeepSeek V4.1 Flash book into a cozy retro terminal garden. The terminal displays an absurdly long scroll of code and reasoning that winds into blooming vines, representing the 1,048,576-token context window; a small eager Monitor Robot holds a tool-shaped wand beside it.
